name: English

_purpose.start_line: said once at session start into Claude's context: which rules are on; calm and factual, a fact about the setup, not a warning
_purpose.no_policy: stands in start_line when the company has written no policy file yet
_purpose.start_denied_route: said at session start when the session itself runs on a provider the company's profile forbids; it must be unmistakable, without alarm
_purpose.start_local: said at session start in the red window (routecall's local-red profile, a model on this computer); it reassures: red folders are open because nothing leaves
_purpose.block_prompt: the reason shown to the person when their message is stopped; {found} lists what was found, masked; it reassures that nothing left
_purpose.block_tool: the reason Claude reads when one of its steps is stopped; Claude retells it to the person
_purpose.advice: the way forward after a stop; it gives the person two working paths, never only a ban
_purpose.red_path: why a red folder is not read by a model in the cloud; says where it can be read
_purpose.denied_route: one reason: the session's provider is not allowed by the profile
_purpose.denied_target: one reason: a host or a model named in a step is not allowed by the profile
_purpose.kimi: why Kimi's agent may not work in this folder, and what kind of folder it may work in
_purpose.grok: why Grok's agent may not work in this folder, and how to make the copy it may work on
_purpose.agy: why agy is never given a permission for everything, and the other way to give it the text
_purpose.mark_by_person: why Claude may not mark a folder itself; who does it and how
_purpose.fail_closed: shown when the guard itself failed and the company asked to stop rather than pass; calm, with the next step
_purpose.red_offline: why a step is stopped in the red window, the one window that opens red folders: {what} would reach beyond this computer; calm, says where the step can be done
_purpose.own_file: why a step that opens gatecall's own journal or key is stopped, in any window; says how to see what was stopped instead; calm, a fact, not an accusation
_purpose.own_output: Claude reads it beside a step's output when gatecall took the company's journal key out of it; says the rest of the output is untouched, so Claude goes on with the work instead of hunting for the missing text; calm, a fact
_purpose.kinds: short names of what was found, as a person says them
_purpose.id_context: words of this language that stand next to a national ID number; they let gatecall tell an ID from any other number

start_line: gatecall: profile {profiles}, company policy {policy}; {red} red folder(s) stay on this computer; keys, card numbers, IBANs, ID numbers and lists of addresses or phone numbers are stopped before they leave.
start_denied_route: This session runs on {what}, which the profile {profile} does not allow: every message will be stopped. Tell the person, and start Claude Code without it.
start_local: This session runs on a model on this computer ({host}): red folders are open to it, and nothing leaves.
block_prompt: gatecall stopped this message before it left the computer: {found}.
block_tool: gatecall stopped this step before anything left the computer: {found}.
advice: Take these out or mask them (the last four characters are enough), or do this work on the company's own model on this computer (routecall's local-red profile).
red_path: {path} is in a red folder: its content stays on this computer, and the red window reads it - a model on this computer, opened with routecall's local-red profile.
denied_route: This session runs on {what}, which the profile {profile} does not allow.
denied_target: {what} is not allowed by the profile {profile}.
kimi: Kimi's agent works only in a training folder of practice files, and {folder} is not one: Kimi has no read-only switch.
grok: Grok's agent works only on a cleaned copy, and {folder} is not one: gatecall's copy command makes one without red folders and key files.
agy: agy never gets a permission for everything: it would hold for every later agy session on this computer. Put the text inside the question instead.
mark_by_person: Only a person marks a training folder: they run the mark command themselves, in their own terminal.
fail_closed: gatecall could not check this, and the company's policy asks to stop when unsure. Try once more; if it repeats, the one who set up the company's AI looks at gatecall's journal.
red_offline: The red window works without the network, and {what} would reach beyond this computer. Do this step in an ordinary window, without the red files.
own_file: {path} belongs to gatecall itself - its journal of stops and the company's journal key - and only gatecall opens it. To see what was stopped, run gatecall's journal command: it shows every stop, without the values.
own_output: gatecall took the company's journal key out of this output: only gatecall reads it. The rest of the output is as the step gave it.
